label: PF Backlog 1
title: WG-O1: Rename auth env to PF_API_TOKEN (back-compat) + wg token_env + env registry + docs
body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-0360. Source: docs/WORKER-SCHEDULER-OPERATIONS.md.

brief.problem: Auth env is generic API_TOKEN; per-clone tokens are random so cross-session access 401s.
brief.what_adds: PF_API_TOKEN as the single named env (with API_TOKEN/DASHBOARD_API_TOKEN fallback); wg token_env updated; registered in config/env-flags.json; docs updated.
brief.why: One clearly-named shared token everyone references for starting/accessing the API.

objective: Introduce PF_API_TOKEN as the canonical auth env with full back-compat.
acceptance_criteria: auth.py resolves PF_API_TOKEN first, then API_TOKEN (the legacy DASHBOARD_API_TOKEN fallback removed - BI-PF-1325 amendment, operator-approved).
dev_server.py sets/uses PF_API_TOKEN (respects a pre-set value).
PF_API_TOKEN registered in config/env-flags.json; docs updated.
approach: Add PF_API_TOKEN ahead of API_TOKEN in _flag resolution; keep fallbacks; register the flag; update dev_server + wg config + docs.
verification: API accepts PF_API_TOKEN; old API_TOKEN still works (fallback).
risks: breaking clients that only set API_TOKEN (mitigated by fallback).

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/env_flags.py and config/env-flags.json to register PF_API_TOKEN as canonical with legacy env var fallback; add token_env field to worker-group config; update docs/WORKER-SCHEDULER-OPERATIONS.md.
dependency_findings: No hard deps; blocks BI-PF-1326 which needs shared token naming
conflict_findings: None concurrent; env-flags.json not touched by sibling WG items
duplication_findings: No existing PF_API_TOKEN rename item in backlog
config/env-flags.json already serves as env registry - reuse, do not create new registry
analysis.rationale: Pure extension of existing env registry pattern; low risk, unblocks token sharing in WG-O2.
assumptions: Legacy env var name is discoverable from env_flags.py
token_env lives in worker-group JSON config
risks: Silent breakage if any deploy lacks back-compat fallback
Docs drift if other WG docs not cross-updated
missing_info: Exact legacy env var name for fallback
Which worker-group config file carries token_env

context_review.reason: Candidate components clearly map to env registry pattern; only naming detail pending.
